observations: Photo 0: a single rectangular glass panel with clipped corners and bevelled edges, leaning against a wall on a concrete floor.
The panel has a black painted backing with a white floral and butterfly print in the middle.
The black backing is peeling or flaking in large patches around the edges, leaving clear glass showing through.
Four chrome leg-mounting pads near the corners and four small bolt heads are fixed to the glass; no legs or base are present.
A faint thin branching line near the top centre could be a reflection or a crack; it is not clear in this photo.
No brand, label or tempered-glass stamp is visible.

identity.kind: rectangular black glass center table top only, without legs
